messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

che tu mi meni là dov' or dicesti, sì ch'io veggia la porta di san Pietro e color cui tu fai cotanto mesti».
**Malayalam translation**
നീ എന്നെ അവിടെ നയിക്കട്ടെ, നീ ഇപ്പോൾ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ, അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ സെയ്ന്റ് പീറ്ററിന്റെ വാതിൽ കാണാൻ കഴിയും മറ്റും നീ അത്രയും ദുഃഖിതരാക്കുന്നവരും».

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Malayalam)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | che | subordinating conjunction introducing purpose clause | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (conjunction omitted in Malayalam) | | tu (1) | 2nd sg. pronoun, subject of *meni* | നീ | you | OK | | mi | 1st sg. pronoun, object of *meni* | എന്നെ | me | OK | | meni | verb “to lead” (subjunctive) | നയിക്കട്ടെ | (let) lead | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | അവിടെ | there | OK | | dov' | relative adverb “where” (refers to the place previously mentioned) | പോലെ | as/like (in “പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ”) | OK | | or | temporal adverb “now” | ഇപ്പോൾ | now | OK | | dicesti | verb “you said” (past) | പറഞ്ഞത് | said | OK | | sì | adverb “so, thus” (introducing result) | അങ്ങനെ | so, thus | OK | | ch'io | 1st sg. pronoun “I” (subject of *veggia*) | ഞാൻ | I | OK | | veggia | verb “may see” (subjunctive) | കാണാൻ | to see (potential) | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (articles not expressed in Malayalam) | | porta | noun “gate” | വാതിൽ | gate | OK | | di | preposition “of” (genitive) | യുടെ | of | OK | | san | honorific “Saint” | സെയ്ന്റ് | Saint | OK | | Pietro | proper name “Peter” | പീറ്റർ | Peter | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | മറ്റും | and | OK | | color | demonstrative plural “those” | അവരും | those (plural) | OK | | cui | relative pronoun “whom” | അവരെ | whom | OK | | tu (2) | 2nd sg. pronoun, subject of *fai* | നീ | you | OK | | fai | verb “you make/ cause” | ദുഃഖിതരാക്കുന്ന | afflict (make sad) | OK | | cotanto | degree adverb “so much” | അത്രയും | so much | OK | | mesti | adjective “afflicted, sad” (plural) | ദുഃഖിതരാക്കുന്നവരും | those who are afflicted | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `che`, `la` – these elements are naturally omitted in Malayalam and therefore do not appear in the target rendering. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
